text:
anya: quick pulse-check: should we gate quant profiles with CI + runtime admission before we let them into canary?

matt: yes. 2 layers: static CI lint + runtime admission call during deploy. keep static cheap.

priya: static lint catches schema issues and obvious anti-patterns. runtime admission should evaluate hardware compatibility and fallback reachability.

jordan: Agree. Static rules I want: no fp8 without declared fallback, quality_anchor present, and explicit hw_compat list if using fp8.

anya: Could we make hw_compat required when allowed_precisions includes fp8? Otherwise folks assume fp8 parity across GPUs.

matt: make sense. Also surface a soft-warning if model indicates fp8 OK but we havent run headwise tests.

priya: Proposed minimal DSL for profiles (example):
```yaml
profile:
  model: opt-6.7b
  allowed_precisions: [fp8, int8]
  quality_anchor: evals/qa-v2
  fallbacks: [int8]
  hw_compat: [a100, h100]
  requires_canary: true
  notes: "headwise-int4 not tested"
```

jordan: Linter rules:
- allowed_precisions subset of runtime-supported_precisions (static manifest)
- fallbacks non-empty if fp8 in allowed_precisions
- no cycles in fallback chain
- requires_canary true if quality_anchor missing or small eval set

matt: we should also add an automated "recommendation" fix: if hw_compat missing and fp8 present, add a warning and suggest a conservative hw list. lint --fix could add the suggestion as a commented field.

anya: runtime admission API sketch: deploy-agent posts profile to runtime /admit endpoint, runtime returns JSON like:
```json
{"allowed": true, "warnings": ["kv-cache=false may break fp8 paths"], "recommended_variant": "int8-safe"}
```

priya: runtime will run quick checks: model binary supports fp8 kernels on target hw, kv-cache flag compat, quant profile version match. No heavy evals.

jordan: If runtime returns allowed=false, we block rollout and surface error in console + PR. Ops oncall can override with explicit justification (and audit log).

matt: Integrate with GitHub Actions: precision-lint runs on PRs, emits SARIF and annotations. If it passes, deploy pipeline calls runtime/admit and fails if allowed=false.

ci-bot: precision-lint action v0.2 released: default rule set + experimental headwise ban.

anya: migration plan for legacy profiles: codemod that converts shape -> DSL, mark missing quality_anchor as requires_canary, and open PRs for manual review.

priya: also add a small "hardness" field: expected quality sensitivity (low/medium/high) so ops can set canary length automatically.

jordan: good idea. standardize canary durations in playbook based on hardness and customer tier.

matt: one last ops note: console should show lint status, runtime admission verdict, and hardness. block global rollout unless both green.

anya: action items: matt+priya = DSL + lint rules PR, jordan = runtime/admit schema, anya = CI GH action + codemod scaffold. will open initial draft branch.

priya: Ill prototype a sample profile and add to docs/examples. ping @matt for review.

matt: Ill add readme caveat about fp8 hardware variance and headwise risk.
